verdict.rationale: Token2's tooling has only narrow background automation: a small headless watcher (`fido2_tray.py`) opens the GUI automatically when a key is inserted. Separately, there is a scriptable PowerShell/Graph API tool for automated bulk Entra ID registration, but it is run on demand rather than as a background job. Neither amounts to user-configurable autonomous automations. Missing for 10: user-defined automation/workflow setup, scheduled or trigger-based background jobs beyond GUI launch, agent-driven autonomous execution, and independent corroboration.
